description: This file defines models and database views for an event management module in an OpenERP (Odoo) system, including classes for events, registrations, event types, and reporting views.

classes.name: crm_case_log
classes.description: Extends osv.osv to add default behavior for crm.case.log, including a create method that sets a default name if not provided.

classes.name: event_type
classes.description: Defines the 'event.type' model with a single 'name' field representing the type of event.

classes.name: event
classes.description: Defines the 'event.event' model with fields for event details, methods for state transitions, copying, and related computations for registration counts.

classes.name: event_registration
classes.description: Defines the 'event.registration' model inheriting from 'crm.case', managing event sign-ups, email notifications, and invoice line creation.

classes.name: report_event_registration
classes.description: Database view model summarizing events and registration counts, with an init method creating the view.

classes.name: report_event_type_registration
classes.description: Database view model summarizing registration counts by event type, with an init method creating the view.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new record, with custom logic for crm_case_log and event_registration to set default values and log history.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates records, with logic to cascade date and description changes to related registrations.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates an event, generating a new sequence code and resetting its state to draft.

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the event and sends confirmation emails if auto-confirm is enabled.

methods.name: _get_register
methods.description: Computes the number of confirmed registrations for an event.

methods.name: _get_prospect
methods.description: Computes the number of unconfirmed (draft) registrations for an event.

methods.name: _history
methods.description: Logs case history entries for registration actions.

methods.name: button_reg_close
methods.description: Marks registration as done and logs history.

methods.name: mail_user
methods.description: Sends registration or confirmation emails based on event settings.
